name: Ordrivo Lite – Restaurant Online Ordering
author: ordrivo

sections.description:
Ordrivo Lite gives restaurants a direct ordering page on their own WordPress website.

Features include an editable starter menu, responsive customer ordering, customer name and phone capture, optional postcode restrictions, a browser-based restaurant terminal, pickup-time confirmation, order status handling and browser/system printing.

The plugin does not require an external ordering service and does not charge commission on orders.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress.org plugin directory when available.
  2. Activate Ordrivo Lite.
  3. Open Ordrivo Lite in WordPress admin and edit the restaurant details and menu.
  4. Add [ordrivo_order] to the customer ordering page.
  5. Add [ordrivo_terminal] to a private terminal page or open the terminal from the Ordrivo Lite admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does Ordrivo Lite charge commission?

No. Orders are stored on your WordPress website.

Can I edit the menu?

Yes. You can edit the starter products and add your own products, categories, descriptions and prices.

Does it support delivery?

Version 1.0.0 is focused on pickup ordering.

Does printing require special hardware?

The Lite plugin uses the browser/system print workflow. Printer behavior depends on the device, browser and printer configuration.
